name: concept-map-generator
description: IMA book → concept map Web reader

scripts.predev: npm run build-index && npm run sync-maps
scripts.prebuild: npm run build-index && npm run sync-maps
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build-index && npm run sync-maps && npm --prefix apps/web-mobile run build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --prefix apps/web wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name concept-map-generator
scripts.deploy:mobile: npm run build:mobile && npx wrangler pages deploy apps/web-mobile/dist --project-name concept-map-mobile
